en.text: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 我的民哪，你们要留心听我的训诲， 侧耳听我口中的话。

zhTraditional.text: 我的民哪，你們要留心聽我的訓誨， 側耳聽我口中的話。

en.text: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

zhSimplified.text: 我要开口说比喻； 我要说出古时的谜语，

zhTraditional.text: 我要開口說比喻； 我要說出古時的謎語，

en.text: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

zhSimplified.text: 是我们所听见、所知道的， 也是我们的祖宗告诉我们的。

zhTraditional.text: 是我們所聽見、所知道的， 也是我們的祖宗告訴我們的。

en.text: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

zhSimplified.text: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒， 要将耶和华的美德和他的能力， 并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。

zhTraditional.text: 我們不將這些事向他們的子孫隱瞞， 要將耶和華的美德和他的能力， 並他奇妙的作為，述說給後代聽。

en.text: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

zhSimplified.text: 因为，他在雅各中立法度， 在以色列中设律法； 是他吩咐我们祖宗要传给子孙的，

zhTraditional.text: 因為，他在雅各中立法度， 在以色列中設律法； 是他吩咐我們祖宗要傳給子孫的，

en.text: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

zhSimplified.text: 使将要生的后代子孙可以晓得； 他们也要起来告诉他们的子孙，

zhTraditional.text: 使將要生的後代子孫可以曉得； 他們也要起來告訴他們的子孫，

en.text: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

zhSimplified.text: 好叫他们仰望 神， 不忘记 神的作为， 惟要守他的命令。

zhTraditional.text: 好叫他們仰望上帝， 不忘記上帝的作為， 惟要守他的命令。

en.text: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

zhSimplified.text: 不要像他们的祖宗， 是顽梗悖逆、居心不正之辈， 向着 神，心不诚实。

zhTraditional.text: 不要像他們的祖宗， 是頑梗悖逆、居心不正之輩， 向着上帝，心不誠實。

en.text: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

zhSimplified.text: 以法莲的子孙带着兵器，拿着弓， 临阵之日转身退后。

zhTraditional.text: 以法蓮的子孫帶着兵器，拿着弓， 臨陣之日轉身退後。

en.text: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

zhSimplified.text: 他们不遵守 神的约， 不肯照他的律法行；

zhTraditional.text: 他們不遵守上帝的約， 不肯照他的律法行；

en.text: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

zhSimplified.text: 又忘记他所行的 和他显给他们奇妙的作为。

zhTraditional.text: 又忘記他所行的 和他顯給他們奇妙的作為。

en.text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

zhSimplified.text: 他在埃及地，在琐安田， 在他们祖宗的眼前施行奇事。

zhTraditional.text: 他在埃及地，在瑣安田， 在他們祖宗的眼前施行奇事。

en.text: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

zhSimplified.text: 他将海分裂，使他们过去， 又叫水立起如垒。

zhTraditional.text: 他將海分裂，使他們過去， 又叫水立起如壘。

en.text: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

zhSimplified.text: 他白日用云彩， 终夜用火光引导他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他白日用雲彩， 終夜用火光引導他們。

en.text: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

zhSimplified.text: 他在旷野分裂磐石， 多多地给他们水喝，如从深渊而出。

zhTraditional.text: 他在曠野分裂磐石， 多多地給他們水喝，如從深淵而出。

en.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

zhSimplified.text: 他使水从磐石涌出， 叫水如江河下流。

zhTraditional.text: 他使水從磐石湧出， 叫水如江河下流。

en.text: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

zhSimplified.text: 他们却仍旧得罪他， 在干燥之地悖逆至高者。

zhTraditional.text: 他們卻仍舊得罪他， 在乾燥之地悖逆至高者。

en.text: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

zhSimplified.text: 他们心中试探 神， 随自己所欲的求食物，

zhTraditional.text: 他們心中試探上帝， 隨自己所欲的求食物，

en.text: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

zhSimplified.text: 并且妄论 神说： 神在旷野岂能摆设筵席吗？

zhTraditional.text: 並且妄論上帝說： 上帝在曠野豈能擺設筵席嗎？

en.text: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

zhSimplified.text: 他曾击打磐石，使水涌出，成了江河； 他还能赐粮食吗？ 还能为他的百姓预备肉吗？

zhTraditional.text: 他曾擊打磐石，使水湧出，成了江河； 他還能賜糧食嗎？ 還能為他的百姓預備肉嗎？

en.text: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

zhSimplified.text: 所以，耶和华听见就发怒； 有烈火向雅各烧起； 有怒气向以色列上腾；

zhTraditional.text: 所以，耶和華聽見就發怒； 有烈火向雅各燒起； 有怒氣向以色列上騰；

en.text: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们不信服 神， 不倚赖他的救恩。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們不信服上帝， 不倚賴他的救恩。

en.text: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 他却吩咐天空， 又敞开天上的门，

zhTraditional.text: 他卻吩咐天空， 又敞開天上的門，

en.text: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

zhSimplified.text: 降吗哪，像雨给他们吃， 将天上的粮食赐给他们。

zhTraditional.text: 降嗎哪，像雨給他們吃， 將天上的糧食賜給他們。

en.text: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

zhSimplified.text: 各人吃大能者的食物； 他赐下粮食，使他们饱足。

zhTraditional.text: 各人吃大能者的食物； 他賜下糧食，使他們飽足。

en.text: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

zhSimplified.text: 他领东风起在天空， 又用能力引了南风来。

zhTraditional.text: 他領東風起在天空， 又用能力引了南風來。

en.text: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

zhSimplified.text: 他降肉，像雨在他们当中，多如尘土， 又降飞鸟，多如海沙，

zhTraditional.text: 他降肉，像雨在他們當中，多如塵土， 又降飛鳥，多如海沙，

en.text: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

zhSimplified.text: 落在他们的营中， 在他们住处的四面。

zhTraditional.text: 落在他們的營中， 在他們住處的四面。

en.text: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

zhSimplified.text: 他们吃了，而且饱足； 这样就随了他们所欲的。

zhTraditional.text: 他們吃了，而且飽足； 這樣就隨了他們所欲的。

en.text: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

zhSimplified.text: 他们贪而无厌， 食物还在他们口中的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 他們貪而無厭， 食物還在他們口中的時候，

en.text: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 神的怒气就向他们上腾， 杀了他们内中的肥壮人， 打倒以色列的少年人。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的怒氣就向他們上騰， 殺了他們內中的肥壯人， 打倒以色列的少年人。

en.text: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

zhSimplified.text: 虽是这样，他们仍旧犯罪， 不信他奇妙的作为。

zhTraditional.text: 雖是這樣，他們仍舊犯罪， 不信他奇妙的作為。

en.text: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，他叫他们的日子全归虚空， 叫他们的年岁尽属惊恐。

zhTraditional.text: 因此，他叫他們的日子全歸虛空， 叫他們的年歲盡屬驚恐。

en.text: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

zhSimplified.text: 他杀他们的时候，他们才求问他， 回心转意，切切地寻求 神。

zhTraditional.text: 他殺他們的時候，他們才求問他， 回心轉意，切切地尋求上帝。

en.text: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

zhSimplified.text: 他们也追念 神是他们的磐石， 至高的 神是他们的救赎主。

zhTraditional.text: 他們也追念上帝是他們的磐石， 至高的上帝是他們的救贖主。

en.text: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 他们却用口谄媚他， 用舌向他说谎。

zhTraditional.text: 他們卻用口諂媚他， 用舌向他說謊。

en.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 因他们的心向他不正， 在他的约上也不忠心。

zhTraditional.text: 因他們的心向他不正， 在他的約上也不忠心。

en.text: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

zhSimplified.text: 但他有怜悯， 赦免他们的罪孽， 不灭绝他们， 而且屡次消他的怒气， 不发尽他的忿怒。

zhTraditional.text: 但他有憐憫， 赦免他們的罪孽， 不滅絕他們， 而且屢次消他的怒氣， 不發盡他的忿怒。

en.text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

zhSimplified.text: 他想到他们不过是血气， 是一阵去而不返的风。

zhTraditional.text: 他想到他們不過是血氣， 是一陣去而不返的風。

en.text: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

zhSimplified.text: 他们在旷野悖逆他， 在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢！

zhTraditional.text: 他們在曠野悖逆他， 在荒地叫他擔憂，何其多呢！

en.text: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 他们再三试探 神， 惹动以色列的圣者。

zhTraditional.text: 他們再三試探上帝， 惹動以色列的聖者。

en.text: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

zhSimplified.text: 他们不追念他的能力 和赎他们脱离敌人的日子；

zhTraditional.text: 他們不追念他的能力 和贖他們脫離敵人的日子；

en.text: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

zhSimplified.text: 他怎样在埃及地显神迹， 在琐安田显奇事，

zhTraditional.text: 他怎樣在埃及地顯神蹟， 在瑣安田顯奇事，

en.text: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

zhSimplified.text: 把他们的江河并河汊的水都变为血， 使他们不能喝。

zhTraditional.text: 把他們的江河並河汊的水都變為血， 使他們不能喝。

en.text: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

zhSimplified.text: 他叫苍蝇成群落在他们当中，嘬尽他们， 又叫青蛙灭了他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他叫蒼蠅成群落在他們當中，嘬盡他們， 又叫青蛙滅了他們，

en.text: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

zhSimplified.text: 把他们的土产交给蚂蚱， 把他们辛苦得来的交给蝗虫。

zhTraditional.text: 把他們的土產交給螞蚱， 把他們辛苦得來的交給蝗蟲。

en.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

zhSimplified.text: 他降冰雹打坏他们的葡萄树， 下严霜打坏他们的桑树，

zhTraditional.text: 他降冰雹打壞他們的葡萄樹， 下嚴霜打壞他們的桑樹，

en.text: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

zhSimplified.text: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹， 把他们的群畜交给闪电。

zhTraditional.text: 又把他們的牲畜交給冰雹， 把他們的群畜交給閃電。

en.text: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

zhSimplified.text: 他使猛烈的怒气和忿怒、恼恨、苦难 成了一群降灾的使者，临到他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他使猛烈的怒氣和忿怒、惱恨、苦難 成了一群降災的使者，臨到他們。

en.text: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

zhSimplified.text: 他为自己的怒气修平了路， 将他们交给瘟疫， 使他们死亡，

zhTraditional.text: 他為自己的怒氣修平了路， 將他們交給瘟疫， 使他們死亡，

en.text: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

zhSimplified.text: 在埃及击杀一切长子， 在含的帐棚中击杀他们强壮时头生的。

zhTraditional.text: 在埃及擊殺一切長子， 在含的帳棚中擊殺他們強壯時頭生的。

en.text: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

zhSimplified.text: 他却领出自己的民如羊， 在旷野引他们如羊群。

zhTraditional.text: 他卻領出自己的民如羊， 在曠野引他們如羊群。

en.text: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 他领他们稳稳妥妥地，使他们不致害怕； 海却淹没他们的仇敌。

zhTraditional.text: 他領他們穩穩妥妥地，使他們不致害怕； 海卻淹沒他們的仇敵。

en.text: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

zhSimplified.text: 他带他们到自己圣地的边界， 到他右手所得的这山地。

zhTraditional.text: 他帶他們到自己聖地的邊界， 到他右手所得的這山地。

en.text: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

zhSimplified.text: 他在他们面前赶出外邦人， 用绳子将外邦的地量给他们为业， 叫以色列支派的人住在他们的帐棚里。

zhTraditional.text: 他在他們面前趕出外邦人， 用繩子將外邦的地量給他們為業， 叫以色列支派的人住在他們的帳棚裏。

en.text: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

zhSimplified.text: 他们仍旧试探、悖逆至高的 神， 不守他的法度，

zhTraditional.text: 他們仍舊試探、悖逆至高的上帝， 不守他的法度，

en.text: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

zhSimplified.text: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样； 他们改变，如同翻背的弓。

zhTraditional.text: 反倒退後，行詭詐，像他們的祖宗一樣； 他們改變，如同翻背的弓。

en.text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

zhSimplified.text: 因他们的邱坛惹了他的怒气； 因他们雕刻的偶像触动他的愤恨。

zhTraditional.text: 因他們的邱壇惹了他的怒氣； 因他們雕刻的偶像觸動他的憤恨。

en.text: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

zhSimplified.text: 神听见就发怒， 极其憎恶以色列人。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝聽見就發怒， 極其憎惡以色列人。

en.text: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

zhSimplified.text: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕， 就是他在人间所搭的帐棚；

zhTraditional.text: 甚至他離棄示羅的帳幕， 就是他在人間所搭的帳棚；

en.text: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

zhSimplified.text: 又将他的约柜交与人掳去， 将他的荣耀交在敌人手中；

zhTraditional.text: 又將他的約櫃交與人擄去， 將他的榮耀交在敵人手中；

en.text: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑， 向他的产业发怒。

zhTraditional.text: 並將他的百姓交與刀劍， 向他的產業發怒。

en.text: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

zhSimplified.text: 少年人被火烧灭； 处女也无喜歌。

zhTraditional.text: 少年人被火燒滅； 處女也無喜歌。

en.text: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司倒在刀下， 寡妇却不哀哭。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司倒在刀下， 寡婦卻不哀哭。

en.text: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，主像世人睡醒， 像勇士饮酒呼喊。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，主像世人睡醒， 像勇士飲酒呼喊。

en.text: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

zhSimplified.text: 他就打退了他的敌人， 叫他们永蒙羞辱；

zhTraditional.text: 他就打退了他的敵人， 叫他們永蒙羞辱；

en.text: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

zhSimplified.text: 并且他弃掉约瑟的帐棚， 不拣选以法莲支派，

zhTraditional.text: 並且他棄掉約瑟的帳棚， 不揀選以法蓮支派，

en.text: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

zhSimplified.text: 却拣选犹大支派—他所喜爱的锡安山；

zhTraditional.text: 卻揀選猶大支派－他所喜愛的錫安山；

en.text: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

zhSimplified.text: 盖造他的圣所，好像高峰， 又像他建立永存之地；

zhTraditional.text: 蓋造他的聖所，好像高峰， 又像他建立永存之地；

en.text: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

zhSimplified.text: 又拣选他的仆人大卫， 从羊圈中将他召来，

zhTraditional.text: 又揀選他的僕人大衛， 從羊圈中將他召來，

en.text: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 叫他不再跟从那些带奶的母羊， 为要牧养自己的百姓雅各 和自己的产业以色列。

zhTraditional.text: 叫他不再跟從那些帶奶的母羊， 為要牧養自己的百姓雅各 和自己的產業以色列。

en.text: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，他按心中的纯正牧养他们， 用手中的巧妙引导他们。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，他按心中的純正牧養他們， 用手中的巧妙引導他們。
